summary: Request metrics middleware buckets path labels to a fixed set and maps odd HTTP methods to OTHER, preventing unbounded Prometheus label growth.

statements.why: Only label normalization; no request handling or access change.

statements.text: The agent also changed app/core/metrics/middleware.py, in a way plain can't describe yet.

misses.what: Fixes memory-growth risk: random URLs/methods from anyone created never-freed metric series; now collapse to '/other' and 'OTHER'.
Metric label values change (/backend-api, /internal buckets, '/' and SPA pages as '/other'); dashboards/alerts on old labels go blank.
